# Feathers

Type: Material | Internal ID: Feathers | Source: Birds, Chests, Felled trees | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

## Availability

• Dropped by Gulls, Crows, Hens, Chickens, Ash crows, and Voltures.
• Found within chests in the Meadows and Black Forest biomes, along with chests found throughout Burial Chambers.
• Chance to drop when chopping down Beech and Fir trees.

### Building

• Dragon bed
